title: Shopify Profit Margin, Break-Even ROAS & CPA Calculator
meta_description: Calculate true net profit per Shopify order, payment processing fees, return reserves, break-even ROAS, and maximum profitable CPA.
lead: Know your exact profit per order, break-even ROAS, and maximum affordable ad CPA before scaling paid traffic.
formula_html:
Break-Even CPA = Selling Price - COGS - Shipping - Card Fee - Refund Reserve.

Break-Even ROAS = Selling Price / Break-Even CPA. Any ROAS higher than Break-Even ROAS generates net positive contribution margin.

faqs.q: What is a healthy break-even ROAS for a Shopify store?
faqs.a: Most direct-to-consumer brands target a break-even ROAS between 1.5x and 2.2x so there is enough room to scale Meta, TikTok, or Google ads profitably.

faqs.q: When does upgrading from Basic to Shopify Grow pay for itself?
faqs.a: Dropping card fees from 2.9% to 2.7% saves $2 per $1,000 in GMV. Once your store passes roughly $25,000–$30,000 in monthly card volume, the fee savings often exceed the subscription difference.
